mapper.insert: INSERT INTO PDF_JOB ( JOB_ID, STATUS, CREATE_DATE ) VALUES ( #{jobid}, #{status}, getdate() )
mapper.update: UPDATE PDF_JOB SET STATUS = #{status}, START_DATE = GETDATE(), UPDATE_DATE = GETDATE() WHERE JOB_ID = #{jobid}
UPDATE PDF_JOB SET STATUS = #{status}, COMPLETE_DATE = GETDATE(), UPDATE_DATE = GETDATE() WHERE JOB_ID = #{jobid}
UPDATE PDF_JOB SET STATUS = #{status}, ERROR_MESSAGE = #{errorMessage}, UPDATE_DATE = GETDATE() WHERE JOB_ID = #{jobid}
mapper.select: SELECT JOB_ID AS jobid, STATUS AS status, FILE_PATH AS filepath, CREATE_DATE AS createdate, COMPLETE_DATE AS completedate FROM PDF_JOB WHERE JOB_ID = #{jobid}

SELECT JOB_ID AS jobid, STATUS AS status, FILE_PATH AS filepath, ERROR_MESSAGE AS errormessage, RETRY_COUNT AS retrycount, CREATE_DATE AS createdate, START_DATE AS startdate, COMPLETE_DATE AS completedate, UPDATE_DATE AS updatedate
FROM PDF_JOB
WHERE STATUS = 'PROCESSING' AND UPDATE_DATE < DATEADD(MINUTE, -30, GETDATE())
